question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql:
SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as num_lines, SUM(qty) as total_qty, AVG(qty) as avg_qty
FROM picking_line 
WHERE order_id = 421 
GROUP BY product_id

{"sql": "WITH product_picking AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_qty, COUNT(*) as num_lines
    FROM picking_line 
    WHERE order_id = 421 
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.purchase_id) as num_purchases, SUM(i.qty) as total_inventory
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN picking_line pl ON i.location_id = pl.location_id
    WHERE pl.order_id = 421
    GROUP BY i.product_id
)
SELECT 
    pp.product_id,
    pp.total_qty,
    pp.num_lines,
    pp.total_qty / pp.num_lines as avg_per_line,
    ppp.num_purchases,
    ppp.total_inventory,
    pp.total_qty / ppp.num_purchases as avg_per_purchase
FROM product_picking pp
JOIN product_purchases ppp ON pp.product_id = ppp.product_id"}
